snippet.title: Yondel 0.1.0 – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Yondel — an infinite-world survival RPG where your journey is completely your own.
In Version 0.1.0, step into a procedurally generated world filled with exploration, crafting, building, and dangerous underground dungeons waiting beneath the surface.

What’s inside Yondel 0.1.0:
• Infinite, procedurally generated terrain
• Survival gameplay with resource gathering
• Crafting & building systems
• Day/night cycle
• Underground dungeons filled with loot and challenges
• Early foundation of the open-world RPG experience

Yondel grows with every update — this trailer showcases the first look at the core systems that will shape the future of the game.

If you want to follow development:
🔗 Wishlist on Steam
🔗 Join the Discord community
🔗 Follow for devlogs and updates

Your adventure in Yondel is just beginning.
